title: Record that three full calls miss the paired-star endpoint.
body: ## Change and mathematical scope Over F_2, at block size 2 and three paired leaves, a stage that uses three or more nonzero projectors commuting with T misses the paired-star pure endpoint. The obstruction is the determinant of the pure word in F_2[x_0, x_1, x_2]. It holds for every call order and every finite list of constant thin maps. Exactly two thin maps of total rank 6 or 7 are the case asked here, and none exist under this call hypothesis. This is a proof, together with an exhaustive matrix census of the finite triple domain. It is not a construction, not a native caller, and not a kappa improvement. The selected frontier stays 781451/250000000. Each nonzero full call has (1+x)-valuation at least 2, and the target factor I+x_j E_j has valuation 4, so a stage has at most two such calls. The 24 ordered pairs that do meet I+xE are the predecessor's twelve orthogonal resolutions. Call lists of length 4 or more are excluded by the same checked valuation, not by a truncated search. ## Task and overlap Base commit: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a` (canonical CrocSwap `main`, re-fetched immediately before submission; it had not moved). This fork draft uses `cursor/crocswap-main-7c49fe32-1dbb` as its base because that branch is the same commit; the fork's own `main` is older. The upstream target is CrocSwap `main`. Task card: `joint-query-controller`, scope refined. The card asks whether a changed query demand removes real work. This package changes one hypothesis of the PR #5747 contract: the number of full calls in a stage. The field stays F_2 and the thin-map count under test stays at two. It does not rerun the two-call rank-8 census. `current-priorities.md` at this base still prints the older decimal 0.00310045. The live selected record is 781451/250000000. This package uses that record and edits neither file. Nearest overlap, from `python3 scripts/find_overlap.py --refresh` at 2026-11-10T02:09:51Z (885 open PRs, 6934 discussion records, complete pagination): - PR #5747 is the contract, the local form, and the rank floor of 6. - Open PR #6922 is the one-thin census. It leaves three or more full calls open. This package takes that clause only. - The two-call rank-8 census is fork branch `cursor/paired-star-two-thin-rank-b55f` at `9888af91b9f9e6dc55efd4172858a7d6093d484b`. Its open question asked this call-count relaxation. This package does not replace that write-up. - `research/two-full-central-obstruction` discusses three FULL calls on a different central-word model. No open upstream PR settles this three-or-more full-call question. Three or more thin maps, and entries outside F_2, are separate questions and are not claimed here. ## Validation Python 3.12, standard library only. From the repository root: ```sh python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-star-three-full-calls ``` Registered status: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `negative-result`. The replay runs the verifier twice, the second time under `python3 -O -B`. Both printed `PASS_PAIRED_STAR_THREE_FULL_CALLS`. The checks raise, so `-O` does not strip them. Receipt: 26 projectors (1 zero, 24 rank-1, 1 unsplit E of valuation 4), 625 ordered pairs with 24 hits, 12 unordered resolutions, 15,625 ordered triples with 0 hits, minimum nonzero valuation 2, target valuation 4. Determinant multiplicativity was checked on every triple. Embeddings were checked on all three stages. A grouped two-stage resolution reproduces the pure target, one extra call moves it, and the constant identity (the pure part of a thin map) does not move it back. `python3 -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py` returned `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY` with selected kappa 781451/250000000. That is a binding check, not a frontier replay. Not run: native caller, Lean, Docker, `make frontier6030-verify`, and a selected-frontier replay. ## Credit The paired-star contract, the local form, and the rank floor are from PR #5747 (Ali Romman), including the predecessor statements in PR #5673, PR #5631, and PR #5617. The two-call census that left this clause open is the fork package cited above. The one-map census is PR #6922. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. ## Open next questions - With one unsplit full call E_j on each stage, do two constant F_2 thin maps of total rank 6 or 7 meet the endpoint at g=3, d=2? The determinant allows this call count. First step: place the three factors I+x_j E_j and solve the two-gap equation. - Can a stage factor that is not a T-commuting projector have (1+x)-valuation 1, so three factors can total valuation 4? First step: one explicit triple of 4-by-4 matrices over F_2 whose product is I+x I_4. ## Workflow feedback The overlap helper's discussion search is the right place to see that PR #6922 already named this clause as open. A useful addition would be a package-local tag for "open next question" text, so a later session can retrieve the clause without reading the whole PR body.
